# Engine E2E shards 1 and 13 time out on the v14 candidate

## Context

The v14 cut steward called for one timing-only repair after Engine Tests timed out twice on the selected 324-spec population. The examples follow-up merge on `aa41c1f139` retained the same Engine test and shard inputs. [Cut record](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21033) · [Merge hold](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21033#issuecomment-7093193157)

## The Problem

Shards 1 and 13 timed out in both [attempt 1](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45121343257/attempts/1) and [attempt 2](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45121343257/attempts/2). In attempt 2, they completed all 95 and 97 test cases, respectively. The separate Workstation popup failure in shard 4 passed on retry.

## The Architectural Reality

`buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` owns selection, allocation and log parsing. Its duration table supplies per-file test seconds and covers runner-side work between tests. The test step has a 360-second deadline. The previous table retained timings from five green full matrices and the measured correction in [#22073](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/22073).

Design authority: [Whitebox E2E timing guidance](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/aa41c1f139dba87d8fd3d9f3075dade0354263d0/learn/guides/testing/WhiteboxE2E.md#L69-L76) and the measured-refresh option in [D#21957](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/21957).

## The Fix

Refresh `buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json` with the greater of its retained historical measurement and each complete new observation. Supply both attempts as separate parser inputs. The rerun supplies the last spec censored by attempt 1. The production allocator replay of the observed envelope reduces peak assigned test time from 375.8 to 345.1 seconds. The hosted full matrix will measure end-to-end time.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Rebuild the timing-only table from the retained baseline and both exact attempts, with all 324 selected spec files represented.
- [ ] Reallocate every current Engine E2E spec exactly once across 15 shards, with the deadline and workflow unchanged. Record a replay estimate against the old table.
- [ ] The full repair PR runs all 15 Engine E2E shards and passes their required aggregate within the current step deadline.
- [ ] Post-merge, verify the full Engine Tests result on the cut candidate and record it on #21033.

## Out of Scope

Shard count, deadline, workflow, coverage, Workstation popup behavior, and release publication.

### @neo-gpt-emmy - 2026-11-23T08:02:38Z

The updated weights also change the automatic runner count for the desktop repair's scoped workload. On #22084 the selected set was 15 files containing 172 tests. With the cut candidate’s old table, the automatic matrix chose two shards, 109 and 63 cases, estimated at 346 and 345 seconds. The first shard timed out twice with 104 and 108 passing cases. The new keyboard case itself passed on the second attempt. An isolated third attempt passed on the unchanged head.

Replaying the **same selection** through the approved `280ea74202` sizing path chooses three shards (47, 56, 69 cases), estimated at **247, 245 and 249 seconds**. Replaying the complete observed per-file timings gives 225.5, 184.0 and 212.5 seconds before startup. Forcing two workers with the new weights would still predict 370/371 seconds. Existing runs retain their original two-worker matrix; this improvement applies to newly created runs using the updated table.
